newsitem.title: BELGIUM: EU declines comment on BA-American meeting with UK.
newsitem.headline: EU declines comment on BA-American meeting with UK.

text.p: The European Commission said it had no comment on a meeting on Tuesday between Competition Commissioner Karel Van Miert and British Trade Secretary Margaret Beckett on the proposed alliance between British Airways and AMR's American Airlines.
"I have no comment," Van Miert's spokesman told the Commission's daily news briefing, adding that it was supposed to remain a "discreet" meeting.

A Commission source told Reuters earlier on Tuesday that the Commission had concluded that the deal would harm competition particularly between the United States and Britain and that the companies would have to make concessions.
The source said later the Commission may make a formal announcement by the end of the week outlining its competition concerns.

The Commission announced in July 1996 it was probing several transatlantic air deals, including the one grouping Lufthansa, SAS and United Airlines, but none of them has been as controversial as the BA-American alliance. -- Brussels newsroom 322 2876841
